name: Cherie Wright - Bayside Ka Huna Massage
title: Cherie Wright - Bayside Ka Huna Massage

texts.text:
Cherie is a Brisbane Bayside Ka Huna Massage and Zenthai Shiatsu therapist with over 20 years’ experience as a bodyworker, yogi, and lover of life.

She offers a safe, intuitive, and confident touch that reflects her depth of experience. Her sessions provide deep nourishment across all layers of being — physical, mental, emotional, and energetic — supporting the body’s natural capacity to restore and rebalance.

Alongside her dedicated practice of Ka Huna and Zenthai, Cherie has explored a range of complementary modalities including remedial massage, Reiki, yoga teaching, Shiatsu and currently in training with Biodynamic Craniosacral Therapy. 

Her learning has taken her on journeys through India, Thailand, New Zealand, and Australia, enriching both her personal path and professional offering.

Through her own life experiences and the imprints they leave, Cherie has walked a path of deep self-inquiry and healing. It is from this place of lived understanding that she holds space — bringing presence, compassion, and grounded wisdom to every session.

Ka Huna Massage is a flowing oil massage practiced on a table, known for its continuous, wave-like movements that attend to the whole body. 

Cherie’s approach weaves in additional techniques, offering a deeply thorough and immersive experience.

Zenthai Shiatsu is received fully clothed on a floor futon, integrating elements of Thai massage, Japanese Shiatsu, and osteopathic principles. Through assisted stretching, joint mobilisation, and steady, mindful pressure, it helps to open the body, improve mobility, support & nourish the natural flow of energy.

While each modality is distinct, both offer the profound benefits of safe, intentional touch and nervous system regulation. It is within this space that the body can soften, unwind, and return to its innate healing intelligence — where the real magic begins.

For more details visit: https://www.baysidekahunamassage.com.au

Contact Cherie for bookings at her ORMISTON Clinic: 0424296020

Ka Huna Massage: 90 mins $170, 2 hrs $220
Zenthai Shiatsu 90 mins $150, 2 hrs $200
Mixed Modalities 90 mins $170, 2 hrs $220
